note:
The accepted-advisory set is EMPTY as of 2026-10-07.

The gate is therefore strict: any advisory appearing in `pnpm audit --prod` now
fails the build. Nothing is tolerated in this file.

How it emptied, in two parts.

1. `@sop/mobile` was excluded from the workspace install (pnpm-workspace.yaml).
   That removed node-forge (GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv), braces (GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm) and
   sprintf-js (GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c) with it. All three arrived only through that
   package's Expo toolchain, none had a published fix, and nothing that ships
   imports it. Preregistration and result: docs/prereg/g9-drop-mobile.md.

2. `sharp` was forced to 0.35.5 (GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w, high). That advisory was
   published to the GitHub Advisory Database on 2026-10-06 — after the dependency
   pass that cleared 36 of 39 — so it was new to the database, not introduced by a
   lockfile change. Unlike the three above it has a published patch, and that patch
   is inside the range @huggingface/transformers already declares (^0.35.4).

History. The 2026-10-06 pass (commit c9de5a2) cleared 36 of 39 advisories with the
overrides in pnpm-workspace.yaml and baselined the three with no fix. That reasoning
is preserved in git history rather than here, because none of it is still in force.
